name: learning-coach
description: A multi-Skill learning system with Topic-local coaching, portfolio planning, read-only views, and a private GitHub-backed Learning Vault.

interface.shortDescription: Learn inside Topics and plan across your learning portfolio
interface.longDescription: Learning Coach is a multi-Skill learning system backed by a user-owned GitHub Learning Vault. Topic Coach handles one chosen Topic's teaching, practice, assessment, roadmap, and learner-state updates; Ask Coach handles portfolio prioritization, global review scheduling, cross-Topic reasoning, candidate Topics, Coach State, and evidence-backed Learning Strategy; Learning View presents state read-only; Vault Curator maintains the Vault. The Plugin declares the canonical GitHub app dependency and never requires PATs or private infrastructure.
defaultPrompt: Use Topic Coach to resume a chosen Topic and continue from its next useful within-Topic action.
Use Ask Coach to decide what I should learn, review, practice, connect, defer, or explore across my Topics.
Use Learning View to show my current learning state without changing it.
Use Ask Coach to recommend whether I should open a new Topic; if I choose it, hand off to Topic Coach to finalize the Topic boundary and initialize it.
Use Vault Curator to review my Learning Vault for structural issues and propose safe refactors.
